title: mirabilis gigantea
intro: Mirabilis gigantea, commonly known as the Giant Four O'Clock, is a flowering plant species in the Four O'Clock family (Nyctaginaceae). The Giant Four O'Clock plant has been traditionally used in medicine due to its potential health benefits, including the reduction of inflammation and the treatment of fever. Its therapeutic actions include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. The plant's bioactive compounds may help to reduce pain, inflammation, and promote wound healing, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
